priorities.summary: Deserialization of untrusted data in Apache Roller versions 4.0.0 through 6.1.4 allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via the XML-RPC endpoint. The issue is being actively exploited; upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.6 or later.
priorities.plain: Apache Roller lets anyone send a crafted request and run code on the blog server — upgrade to version 6.1.6 or later now.

priorities.summary: Deserialization of an inbound SOAP fault in end-of-life Apache Axis 1.x allows unauthenticated remote class instantiation and remote code execution, and has been exploited against products bundling Axis such as Confluence Data Center. CISA added it to the KEV catalog on November 18; no fixed 1.x release will be published, so migrate to a maintained SOAP engine.
priorities.plain: Apache Axis lets attackers run code on servers without logging in and is already being exploited — remove or replace this old software now.

priorities.summary: An unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability in REDCap's survey passthrough routing and Data Import processing lets an attacker who knows a valid public survey hash execute arbitrary code on the server. CISA added it to the KEV catalog on November 18 after active exploitation; upgrade to 16.0.49, 17.3.10 or 17.4.4.
priorities.plain: REDCap lets anyone with a public survey link run code on the research server — upgrade to a fixed release today.
priorities.product: Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap)

model.name: Xing4.1-Preview
model.summary: China Telecom's Xingchen AGI Lab released the open weights of Xing4.1-Preview on November 23, a 285B-parameter mixture-of-experts model for agentic coding and long-horizon work, trained entirely on Huawei Ascend chips and published under Apache 2.0.
model.plain: A large open AI model for coding and multi-step office work that a business can download, inspect and run on its own infrastructure.
